name: Rising
audio: a warm rising choir and soft chimes; no speech
world: The summit is alive: clouds drift and part below, golden motes and white feathers fall, white doves wheel around the pillars and a snow-white deer waits at the edge of the light.

actions.beat: The clouds below part and a column of golden light rises through them, white doves lifting from the summit pillars.
{{She}} floats gently upward out of the column of light, arms lowering slightly, palms open and turned up.

Golden motes and drifting white feathers fall softly around {{her}} as {{her}} eyes glow with {{MAGIC}} light and {{she}} looks to the camera, peaceful and radiant; the snow-white deer watches from the edge of the summit.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
